name: Republic of Negros (1898–1901)
description: A field divided horizontally blue over red with a white triangle at the hoist bearing an orange sun and three stars, modelled on the flag of the Philippine Republic.
history: Sewn by Olympia and Perpetua Severino and Eutropia Yorac and first hoisted at Silay on 5 November 1898 during the Negros Revolution against Spain. The Cantonal Republic of Negros existed under American protection until it was absorbed into the Philippine civil government on 20 April 1901.

features.role: stars at the corners of the triangle
